items.quote: Peers observed that Cyko set the direction for the partnership with sister agencies on youth services across the public service.
Direct reports said that Cyko led delivery under pressure through a demanding year-end peak across the department.
He was recognised sector-wide for his leadership of policy options for the cabinet paper on ageing.
Direct reports said that Cyko Fenuen headed the organisational restructuring of the department, setting priorities for several teams.
Several respondents noted that Cyko Fenuen contributed effectively to financial controls for the grant scheme.
Several respondents noted that Cyko spearheaded the five-year strategic plan for the division at the national level.
Direct reports said that Cyko led trialling a fresh approach to permit queues across the department.
He handled the talent pipeline for the branch competently within his team.
He drove the use of survey numbers to decide where to put new clinics for the whole division.
Direct reports said that Cyko led presentations to senior management across the department.
Direct reports said that Cyko championed the digital redesign of the permit system and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
